messages:
sanjay: Kicking off a config-only deploy to staging now. route_policy=priority-tier, batching.max_inflight 32 -> 24, request_timeout_ms 12000 -> 9000. Rolling to 10% tenant canary for 30m. Start unless objections.
olivia: LGTM from me. Keep an eye on p95/p99 latency and tail error rates. :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: id=cfg-20260213-001 | target=staging | canary=10% | window=30m | changes=[route_policy, batching.max_inflight, request_timeout_ms]
emma: Quick note: pin prod model versions (no model changes) and enable kvcache debug sample=5% for staging so we can correlate evictions with latency. Will flip off after canary.
liam: Obs checklist: 1) p95/p99 per-tenant 2) error-rate per route 3) token-per-request drop 4) kvcache evictions. Dashboard link: https://redwood/obs/rollouts/cfg-20260213-001
zach: If we see >1% errors or p99 > 2x baseline for +5m, do we auto-rollback? what's the exact threshold?
sanjay: Auto-rollback is enabled for this roll: errors >=1% sustained 5m OR p99 >= 2x baseline sustained 5m. Manual rollback command: /deploybot rollback cfg-20260213-001. We'll also escrow a quick hotfix patch if we see kvcache pressure.
deploy-bot: rollout started: id=cfg-20260213-001 | phase=canary | progress=0/10 tenants. Notifying @eng-oncall. React with :thumbsup: to confirm monitoring ownership.
olivia: thumbs up, I'll own latency monitoring and alert triage for the window.
emma: I'll watch kvcache logs and tenant-specific evictions. Will post sample tail logs if anything odd.
liam: tagging runbook: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/config-rollout. If manual rollback needed, call it here and ping SRE.
zach: noted. will be at hand if rollback needed. keeping notifications on. :phone:
